initial_state: first steps observation; encoder offsets applied once
command_time: first matching CAN send on host monotonic clock; zero-order held
controller: logged kp/kd; current MuJoCo scene gravity compensation; optional joint-3 friction candidate
driver_feedforward_reconstruction: approximate KDL gravity with logged factors and simulated velocity sign; not actual recorded command
limitations: driver feedforward uses simulated state or is omitted; no measured torque
stick/slip force uses inverse mass, not a full constrained contact solve
not a fitted or held-out validated model
